## Session Summary

This session finished the UX overhaul on the `feature/ux-overhaul` branch. After switching from broken headless Firefox screenshots to Playwright, we captured the real dashboard and saw the CSS was actually compiling, but the summary metric tiles were too small and the loading state was just a spinner. We added a `PortfolioDashboardSkeleton` so the loading state already looks like the card layout, moved `MetricCard` into shared primitives and increased the metric tiles to a 4-column grid with larger values and context notes, and added coloured status top borders to repository cards. Build and all 210 tests pass; the branch has been published to `origin/feature/ux-overhaul`.
